title.narrative: International Coordinating Committee for the Safeguarding and Development of the Historic Sites of Angkor and Sambor Prei Kuk (ICC-Angkor/Sambor Prei Kuk)

description.narrative: As follow-up of the decision of the First Intergovernmental Conference on Angkor, held in Tokyo in 1993, the working procedures of the Committee were established. It was decided that the ICC-Angkor would be co-chaired by France and Japan in collaboration with the APSARA National Authority, UNESCO provides the services of standing secretariat. The financial mechanism established on the initiative of Japan and France also foresaw that the cost of the ICC-Angkor meetings should be borne by these two countries and UNESCO. Respectively, since 2009, 2019, the APSARA and Sambor Prei Kuk National Authorities have also financially contributed to the ICC meetings. The Site of Sambor Prei Kuk, inscribed on the World Heritage List, was officially included in the mechanism of ICC-Angkor in 2019.
